lines.zh: 我用触手在海底走，一步一探。
lines.en: I walk the sea floor on my tentacles.
My eight tentacles take the ground in turn.
I shift out from behind the reef.

lines.zh: 水里的重量让我走得很稳。
lines.en: The water bears my weight and I walk steady.
I follow the river bed toward the shallows.
I go around a piece of wreck timber.

lines.zh: 我一边走，一边在水里张望。
lines.en: I walk and watch through the water.

lines.zh: 我的触手够到了岸边的石头。
lines.en: My tentacle reaches the shore stones.
Slowly I climb onto the beach.
I walk from the shallows back into the deep.

lines.zh: 我一步一步往海湾里去。
lines.en: Step by step I head into the bay.
I hug the seabed and skirt the weeds.

lines.zh: 我的身体在水里一起一伏。
lines.en: My body rises and falls with the water.
I keep to the sea bed and walk slowly.

lines.zh: 我伏在礁石上，触手摊开。
lines.en: I rest on the reef with my tentacles spread.
Water flows over my body.

lines.zh: 有一条鱼在我触手间穿过。
lines.en: A fish threads between my tentacles.
Underwater I need no air.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛一直盯着上面。
lines.en: My eyes stay fixed upward.
I curl one tentacle up.
The sand on the bed is fine.
The Ink Gun is already loaded.
Something moves in the wreck.
Slowly I turn toward the light.
Everything here tastes of salt.
My tentacles drift in the current.

lines.zh: 我把身体压低，躲进影里。
lines.en: I sink low into the shadow.
The bay is quiet.

lines.zh: 你的靴子离水只差一步。
lines.en: Your boots are one step from the water.

lines.zh: 我的触手比我的身体长。
lines.en: My tentacles are longer than my body.

lines.zh: 你下水的话，就是我这边了。
lines.en: If you come in, it is my ground.
You will not dodge my ink.
Do not stand at the water's edge.
I am in the water under your feet.
I know the floor of this bay.
Once your boots are wet you slow down.

lines.zh: 我八条手臂，你只有两条。
lines.en: I have eight arms. You have two.

lines.zh: 我在水底，八条腕都朝你。
lines.en: I'm on the bottom with all eight arms toward you.
The bottom is deeper than you think.
In the water I am faster than you.
I carry ink, and teeth.
Two steps back and the water is shallow.

lines.zh: 我慢慢把一条触手举起来。
lines.en: Slowly I raise a tentacle.
I have always stayed in this bay.
The tip of one tentacle has parted.
A little darkness spreads in the water.
I retreat behind the reef.
That struck my body.
I can still swim, only slower.
I curl my tentacles in to guard.
One sucker has let go.

lines.zh: 水里看不出来，其实很疼。
lines.en: It does not show in the water, but it hurts.

lines.zh: 我喷了墨，往礁石缝里退。
lines.en: I jet ink and back into the rock crevice.
I sink deeper.
The smell of shellfish I know well.
I reach out a tentacle.
I can pry the meat out of this shell.
Roll it up and into my mouth.
Not good. I drop it.
Too small for one mouthful.

lines.zh: 你扔水里的东西，我接了。
lines.en: What you threw into the water, I took.
I want another.
I am not picky. Anything from the sea.
When finished I withdraw into the deep.
I reach a tentacle into the wreck.
There is something to eat inside.

lines.zh: 你踩进水里，碰到我的触手。
lines.en: You stepped in and touched a tentacle.
I curl once and let go.
One sweep of my arms muddies the water.
Do not stamp on the sea bed.
I retreat a body length deeper.

lines.zh: 这一下，我吸盘贴住了石头。
lines.en: At that my suckers gripped the stone.

lines.zh: 你踩到的只是我的影子。
lines.en: You stepped on nothing but my shadow.
I draw my tentacle back.

lines.zh: 你的靴子在水里站不住。
lines.en: Your boots will not hold in the water.

lines.zh: 我浮起来一点，离你远些。
lines.en: I rise a little, further from you.
There are a few of my kind in this bay.
Each keeps its own stretch of reef.
One of them is close to me.
Our tentacles have touched.

lines.zh: 它的腕比我粗，我让开石头。
lines.en: Its arms are thicker; I yield the rock.

lines.zh: 我们分食过同一只螃蟹。
lines.en: We shared the same crab once.
At night we both rise into the shallows.
Neither enters the other's ground.
This sea holds us all.

lines.zh: 我在这块礁石上待得最久。
lines.en: I have stayed on this reef the longest.
I pick up a shell with a tentacle.
Too hard. I cannot open it.
Something bright in the wreck.
I curl round it and pull it clear.
Too heavy. It drags me down.

lines.zh: 八条腕，海边捡的都归我。
lines.en: Eight arms—whatever the shore gives is mine.
I set it on the reef.
Sand on my suckers.
I can take anything from the sea.
None of it is of use to me.

lines.zh: 我八条腕一齐伸出去，抓得着。
lines.en: All eight arms reach out and catch hold.

lines.zh: 我八条触手轮流落地，沉下去。
lines.en: My eight tentacles step in turn as I sink.

lines.zh: 这个距离，我一条触手就到。
lines.en: One tentacle reaches that far.

lines.zh: 墨囊一挤，先遮住它的眼。
lines.en: I squeeze the ink sac and blind it first.
My color is the color of the water.
I spread my tentacles.
It is swimming this way.

lines.zh: 它再游近半格，我就出手。
lines.en: One more length closer and I strike.
At this range, one arm is enough.
I press my body to the reef.
It is right above me.
I raise one tentacle.
I follow along behind.
It has headed for the shallows.

lines.zh: 它往浅处逃，我顺水抄近。
lines.en: It flees shallower; I cut through the current.
I stretch a tentacle far out.
It looked back and I froze.
It noticed nothing.
I shifted a stretch behind the reef rock.
From here I come from below.
It stops beside the reef.
My tentacle goes round behind it.

lines.zh: 它的尾巴一摆，我跟上去。
lines.en: Its tail flicks; I follow.
I have wrapped it.
I wrap a tentacle round its leg.
My suckers take hold of its skin.

lines.zh: 吸盘咬住它的皮，它挣不动。
lines.en: My suckers clamp its skin; it can't pull free.
Two more tentacles close.
It is dragged toward the water.
I jet ink and the water goes black.

lines.zh: 它看不见我，我看得见它，墨已经备好。
lines.en: It cannot see me; I see it, ink ready.

lines.zh: 我从下面把它的腿卷住。
lines.en: I coil its legs from below.
It kicks twice and hits nothing.
This coil is tight.
It is still struggling.

lines.zh: 我用触手缠住它的腿，吸盘贴住了皮。
lines.en: My tentacle coils its leg, suckers on its hide.
I rise from under the reef.
Seawater runs off me.
This bay is my ground.
I spread my tentacles one by one.

lines.zh: 我贴着沉船的木板浮上来。
lines.en: I rise along the planks of the wreck.

lines.zh: 我旁边有一条沉船的木头。
lines.en: Beside me is a timber from a wreck.
Light comes down through the surface.

lines.zh: 我在水底慢慢转了个身。
lines.en: I turn slowly on the bed.

lines.zh: 有几条鱼躲进礁石缝里。
lines.en: A few fish hide in the reef cracks.

lines.zh: 我触手里攥着墨，先喷你。
lines.en: Ink in my tentacles; you get it first.
The tide here is slack.
I stop at the edge of the weeds.
My eyes are bright in the water.

lines.zh: 我顺着礁石往浅滩上爬。
lines.en: I crawl up the reef toward the shallows.

lines.zh: 水面烫起来，我往深处坠。
lines.en: The surface burns; I drop deeper.

lines.zh: 水退得太快，我摔在礁石上。
lines.en: The water dropped and I fell on the reef.

lines.zh: 我被困在浅坑里，水不够。
lines.en: Trapped in a shallow pool, there is not enough water.

lines.zh: 水里的爆炸把我掀了个身。
lines.en: The blast underwater rolls me over.

lines.zh: 一支鱼叉扎进我的触手。
lines.en: A harpoon is in one of my tentacles.

lines.zh: 墨囊一挤，水里全是黑的。
lines.en: One squeeze and the water goes black.

lines.zh: 海湾里已经没有海鲜了。
lines.en: There is no shellfish left in the bay.

lines.zh: 电顺着海水，麻透我的腕。
lines.en: The current runs through the salt and numbs every arm.
The sea bed split and I fell through.
